So the app's default config is not matching the LDAP bootstrap. The guide says 10 testbenutzer are in test_users.ldif loaded automatically. It doesn't say to configure web.config.local.php to point to them. Maybe the application config has some other way. Let me check the app's code for LDAP usage and login.

Actually the guide's step is just cp the example to local. The example is all commented out, so it falls back to web.config.php (planetexpress). Hmm, that means login wouldn't work with the provided LDIF users unless there's something else. Let me check if there are git-ignored or committed config overrides. Let me look at the app login code and whether LDAP is used.

Actually, maybe the point of the local config being present is that the app detects the file. Let me check web.config.php inclusion.

But wait — the primary task is installation. Verifying the app works by HTTP 200 login page is decent. But let's see if we can actually log in. Let me check what the docs say / cypress tests use for login credentials.
